events.text: In 2021, Sunway established an Internal Carbon Pricing framework at RM15 per tonne of CO2e emitted above a threshold level.
Sunway aims to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050 and halve emissions by 2030.
Sunway Berhad's Board Charter was duly approved and adopted by the Board of Directors at a board meeting held on 10 April 2025.

In 2021, Sunway REIT became the first Malaysian Real Estate Investment Trust to integrate sustainability considerations into its capital management strategy through the issuance of Malaysia's first-ever Sustainability-Linked Medium Term Note (SLMTN) under SUNREIT Bond Berhad.
Sunway Iskandar Development Sdn Bhd published its Sustainable Finance Framework on 22 September 2025.

Sunway Iskandar Development Sdn Bhd completed its first issuance of RM230 million Sustainability Medium-Term Notes under its MTN Programme, with proceeds to part-finance land acquisition and earthwork costs related to the development of Pendas Land in Johor.

The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission filed a RM1.8 million lawsuit against Sunway Lagoon following a food poisoning outbreak during its family day event on Oct 4, 2025, alleging breach of contract and negligence.
Police are investigating possible elements of negligence or sabotage in the Sunway Lagoon roller-coaster incident that left 10 people injured.
MCMC's RM1.85 million lawsuit against Sunway Lagoon Sdn Bhd has moved a step closer to trial following recent court filings.
Sunway Group founder Jeffrey Cheah confirmed a roller coaster accident at Sunway Lagoon injuring 10 individuals, with metal fatigue suspected as a potential cause.
MCMC has taken its RM1.82mil lawsuit against Sunway Lagoon Sdn Bhd a step closer to trial, with the High Court in Shah Alam set to manage the case on April 29 before Justice Anita Harun.
Sunway Construction Group explained that the SPRM investigation launched last month only focuses on personal misconduct of a former employee and does not involve the company or its subsidiaries.

Sunway Construction Group's bidding activities in the RM14 billion data centre segment are expected to be temporarily affected following an SPRM investigation into a staff member's dealings with a subcontractor.
